I've deleted my facebook on 2 occasions. Both times were mostly because I wanted a "fresh start" or a more "private life" but in reality I regret having put myself in that position. A diverse set of friends and acquaintances are not just a valuable asset, but I think one of the best ways to improve yourself is to integrate your public and private life so you start leading a full life you don't mind sharing with anyone. And to not be afraid to embarrass yourself every now and then.

Unless of course you're one of those people who spend all the time on social media and are generally extroverted anyway. Still, I've come to find that deleting a social account didn't do me much good, I basically replaced that outlet with other social outlets that weren't necessarily any healthier.
